**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
***[[Twelve-Day War]] ([[List of airstrikes during the Iran–Israel War|list of airstrikes]])

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 shootings of Minnesota legislators]]
**[[Minnesota Senate|Minnesota state senator]] [[John Hoffman (Minnesota politician)|John Hoffman]], [[Minnesota House of Representatives|state representative]] and former [[List of speakers of the Minnesota House of Representatives|speaker]] [[Melissa Hortman]], and their spouses are shot in two [[Assassination attempt|targeted spree shootings]] at their homes in [[Brooklyn Park, Minnesota|Brooklyn Park]] and [[Champlin, Minnesota|Champlin]], [[Minnesota]], [[United States]]. Hortman and her husband are killed, while the conditions of the Hoffmans are "grave". [https://abcnews.go.com/US/2-minnesota-lawmakers-shot-targeted-incident-officials/story?id=122840751 (ABC News)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/06/shootings-at-homes-of-2-politicians-in-minnesota/ (BNO News)] [https://www.fox9.com/news/brooklyn-park-champlin-shootings-suspect-impersonating-police (KMSP-TV)]
